description: Opaque cream long-sleeved calf-length tunic beneath a rich burgundy long open noble coat. Broad gold geometric and floral woven borders decorate the outer coat's neckline, front opening, broad outer sleeve hems and skirt hem; the cream inner sleeves also have matching ornamental cuffs. A burgundy cloak crosses the chest and one shoulder, fastened by a round gold brooch set with a purple stone. A wide decorated gold-brown belt has a round clasp and a long patterned hanging strap. Dark trousers and dark brown leather boots are visible below the tunic. No armor, headgear or weapon is present.
